verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents automating a tailnet through infrastructure-as-code providers and webhooks, and editing the policy file in a visual editor. Nothing in the evidence shows the product itself versioning, reviewing or rolling back automations or policy changes. Any versioning through IaC would come from the user's own source-control tooling, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
